audit.why: Swain-favored lane that inverts late (55.12% WR, 332 games): you bully the defenceless early Veigar, he closes at first item and wins at 2+ items on stacks and execute R. Both layers and packet agree on that arc.
Spikes complete (4): Lvl 3-5 all-in window, your 6, his first-item catch-up, his late execute. Matches the kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: cooldowns field had no digits; two copy-paste-bleed bullets; full chart rows 0 and 3 said 'Skill' against content/packet Swain; enemyWin was a name-swap template.
audit.why: Event Horizon is 20s rank 1 / 14s max — the single cooldown the lane runs on; Primordial Burst 120/90/60s; his W cooldown scales down with Phenomenal Evil stacks so its zoning grows all game.

edits.before: Q-poke through the wave — the hand hurts more than people remember. Farm safely; your real spells arrive next.
edits.after: Veigar has only Baleful Strike at 1 and no defence — walk up and Q him on every last-hit; the lane opens as a bully job.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-spam stops costing the lane. Poke the wave contact and pull every rooted target with the passive.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay yours — root the immobile Veigar before his stacks or items matter; only Event Horizon delays the dive.

edits.before: - Veigar Event Horizon (Cage): matchup-defining — Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold position near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Nevermove like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Event Horizon (E): 20s rank 1, 14s max — only the cage EDGE stuns; hold near the centre or leave before it forms. That 20s downtime is your all-in window. - Primordial Burst runs 120/90/60s. - Your Nevermove is 12s — walk up on cage-down and root the dive.

edits.before: E his step-up, passive-pull the root for the chunk + heal, Q the retreat — every landed root is a won trade with a health refund attached.
edits.after: Flip R as you commit, not at half HP — the drain must be ticking through his Dark Matter rotation for the burst-vs-sustain math to win.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 like the demon is already online — Swain without R is a slow mage with a dream and a root on cooldown.
edits.after: A whiffed Nevermove is 12s where the cage bully farms free — save the root for his step-ups or your cage-down all-in commits.

edits.before: Veigar wins by landing Event Horizon (Cage), denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Veigar wins by caging your walk-up, stacking Baleful Strike unpunished, and one-shotting you with Primordial Burst late.
